Preserve them pixel for pixel: their onscreen positions and shape, crossing order and depth. The foreground seedling rows remain in place. Original sky, background landmarks, tree, shed number seven, rooflines, borders, perspective, lighting, sunny weather, exposure and white balance stay fixed. No restyling, cropping, zooming or refocusing. The FIRST image is the editable image; do not turn the perspective into the reference.
